d:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.
I care not for the fate of the mage city, friend, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.

With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.
Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?
Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
